notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check that a successful receive-order SendInteraction is delivered as an ordinary application callback while the enabled publisher also produces the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation MOM interaction. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies callback-model timing, standard report metadata, typed supplied and returned arguments, service classification, reliable transportation, serial progression, and ordinary application delivery. Provider-private headers, registries, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
